id.description: Immutable canonical UUID for this project milestone.

schema_version.description: Version of the JSON Schema contract used to validate this record; it changes only through documented repository migrations.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when this repository record was first created; this is audit metadata, not the real-world entity's founding or start date.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest repository record change; it must be updated whenever a structured value or its provenance changes.

source_ids.description: Non-empty set of Source Registry IDs that directly support the observed, estimated, or derived values in this record.

confidence_score.description: Evidence-strength score from 1 (unverified or speculative) to 5 (verified SEC filing), assigned under ASSUMPTIONS.md.

status.description: Current lifecycle classification for the represented entity or record; unknown is used when available evidence does not establish a state.

notes.description: Optional analyst clarification about scope, ambiguity, estimation, or lifecycle context; null means no clarification is recorded and notes never replace structured provenance.

project_id.description: UUID of the Project whose construction sequence contains this milestone; foreign key to Project.id.

name.description: Observed or normalized milestone label describing a verifiable construction event or deliverable.

sequence.description: Non-negative ordinal used to order milestones within a project; equal values are permitted only when activities are intentionally parallel.

planned_date.description: Optional observed or estimated ISO 8601 target date; null when no supported schedule exists.

actual_date.description: Optional observed ISO 8601 completion date; null until completion is verified or when the date is unknown.

completion_percentage.description: Optional observed or estimated completion fraction from 0 to 1; null when percentage reporting is unavailable or inappropriate.

dependency_milestone_ids.description: Deduplicated UUIDs of prerequisite Construction Milestone records; foreign keys to Construction Milestone.id and empty when no dependencies exist.
